digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow orchestration for main-branch CI
propositions: Cancelled GitHub Actions runs on the main branch render as red X marks despite the code being healthy, caused by concurrency group collapse with cancel-in-progress: true
Push triggers on main must be removed and replaced with scheduled 6-hourly runs to prevent per-commit cancellations while preserving non-main branch push CI
Last-known-green commit SHA must be resolved from successful run history and published alongside a copy-pasteable git bisect recipe in the workflow summary to enable rapid regression localization
The new main-health-report job must declare both contents: read and actions: read permissions with explicit GH_TOKEN passing to safely read the Actions API, degrading gracefully when the lookup fails
All touched workflows must retain workflow_dispatch for on-demand manual checks, while preserving existing non-main cadences (weekly for prompt-eval and codeql, daily for terraform-drift)
Gerrit-verify, reconciler workflows, and external-integration.yml remain unchanged; pre-merge gating is unaffected by the mirror's scheduled CI shift
